14.t: Working with data: villi and absorption
q: State the villus height in healthy people.
Calculate how many times more glucose healthy people absorb.
Explain the link between villi and absorption.
Villi give a huge surface area (and thin walls, many capillaries), so more nutrients can be absorbed quickly.
Suggest why people with coeliac disease have a lower mean body mass.
Short villi mean less surface area, so they absorb fewer nutrients from the same food; the body gets less energy for growth.
